تستذكروا (form X)
# تَسْتَذْكِرُوا (tastaḏkirū) /tas.tað.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# تُسْتَذْكَرُوا (tustaḏkarū) /tus.tað.ka.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
